reason: I'd maybe try the free first counted collab with a cafe I already know, but I won't pay ₹499 for a beta from a tiny team when Influish costs the same and already has lakhs of creators and actual brands on it. A 'customers I brought' record only matters if cafe owners actually look at Mitra links, and I haven't seen that yet.
objection: Will South Bengaluru cafe owners even bother with a coupon link I send on WhatsApp, and will the next business care about Mitra counts? If they don't, it's just one more app.
would_change_my_mind: If my free counted collab showed real numbers and a second cafe actually gave me cash, not food, because of that record, I'd pay for the pass.
